Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class AnalyticsService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.AnalyticsService
All Implemented Interfaces:
GetAnalyticsUseCase
public class AnalyticsService extends Object implements GetAnalyticsUseCase
Application-layer service implementing the analytics dashboard use case.

Delegates ingestion and run analytics directly to AnalyticsPort. For evaluation analytics, applies the business rule of identifying the best-performing prompt variant: the variant with the highest average overall score across all its evaluations. This determination is intentionally kept in the domain service rather than the adapter so it can be tested and reasoned about independently of persistence.

This class carries no Spring annotations — it is wired as a @Bean in AppConfig.

    • getEvaluationAnalytics

      public EvaluationAnalytics getEvaluationAnalytics()
      Returns aggregate statistics about prompt evaluations, including per-variant score summaries and the best-performing variant ID.

      After fetching raw aggregates from the port, iterates the variant score list to find the variant with the highest avgOverall and sets bestVariantId on the returned record.
